Two more songs join the surprises.

## New

- **More surprises.** Two more songs the developer loves now come with something extra, across the whole app and in the lyrics. Play them and see.

## Fixed

- **Lyrics no longer break a word in the middle.** Words timed syllable by syllable now stay whole when a line wraps.

## Good to know

- **Some surprises shake the screen or flash it red for a moment.** If Remove animations is on in your Android settings, the screen does not shake.
- **Double tap anywhere to stop a surprise.** It also ends by itself when the song does.
